description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_InventoryRestock" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-restock">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reorder" name="Reorder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryRestock" name="Restock inventory" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Begin monitoring inventory"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_Threshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold" name="Reorder threshold reached?" default="Flow_Threshold_NotReached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_Threshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Threshold_NotReached</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Threshold_Reached</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Threshold_NotReached</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignalReorder" name="Signal need to reorder (automated alert or manual check)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Threshold_Reached</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Signal_PlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with supplier, considering cost, delivery time, and reliability" messageRef="Message_Reorder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Signal_PlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_UpdateDates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update expected delivery dates in inventory system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_UpdateDates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateDates_WaitDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_StockDelivery" name="Receive stock delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateDates_WaitDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delivery_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_StockDelivery" messageRef="Message_StockDelivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectStock" name="Inspect stock quality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delivery_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in the system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Store</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_Store</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Store_UpdateLevels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Store_UpdateLevels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_Reached" name="Threshold reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Task_SignalReorder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock level is at or below the predefined reorder threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_NotReached" name="Threshold not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signal_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Task_SignalReorder" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_UpdateDates" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDates_WaitDelivery" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Event_StockDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivery_Inspect" sourceRef="Event_StockDelivery" targetRef="Task_InspectStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Record" sourceRef="Task_InspectStock" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Store" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_PlaceStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Store_UpdateLevels" sourceRef="Task_PlaceStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevels_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryRestock">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Inventory" name="Warehouse or store" processRef="Process_InventoryRestock"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Supplier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" name="Reorder" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Supplier" messageRef="Message_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery" sourceRef="Participant_Supplier" targetRef="Event_StockDelivery" messageRef="Message_StockDelivery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
